Marissa / Priyom — I've reviewed the draft Exhibit B and price translate sheet. High-level notes:

1) Change order vs. MSA: Based on the content provided the consolidation is scope-of-work (Exhibit) and pricing — that maps cleanly to an Order Form / Change Order. No MSA definition changes detected.

2) Acceptance criteria: The Exhibit still references the same acceptance tests. Keep them verbatim in the Exhibit and add a parenthetical pointer in the order form referencing Exhibit B, to avoid duplication drift.

3) SLA & Warranty: There's language in the draft that rephrases our "service-level credits" section (Exhibit, sect. 3.2). We should not alter the entitlements; instead add an explicit clause in the change order: "No new SLA entitlements are created by this Exhibit consolidation; all SLA terms remain as in the MSA." I can draft the exact sentence.

4) Pricing translation: Priyom — when you map the renamed buckets please include a short mapping table (old label -> new label -> unit price) so Legal and Finance can reconcile. Also add a note on billing cadence changes if any (monthly vs. quarterly invoicing).

5) Signature path: DocuSign is fine. We'll produce a single change-order PDF that contains the consolidated Exhibit B appended; the order form should call out Exhibit version and date.

I can produce redline comments by end of day tomorrow (11/17) and a clean clause for the SLA pointer. If anything changes the MSA definitions we escalate, but I don't expect that here.
